climate_note: Temperatures and weather descriptions are based on long-term historical climatological averages for the entire promotional travel window (1 to 31 October). Values represent typical daily minimum (overnight low) to maximum (afternoon high) temperatures and prevailing seasonal patterns. Specific day-to-day meteorological forecasts become available closer to departure.
